We Do Consulting Differently

Berkeley Research Group (BRG) is a global consulting firm that helps its clients, which consist of leading organizations and businesses, advance in three key areas: disputes and investigations, corporate finance, and performance improvement and advisory. We are an integrated group of experts, industry leaders, academics, data scientists, and economists, working beyond borders and disciplines. We harness our collective expertise to deliver the inspired insights and practical strategies our clients need to stay ahead of what’s next.

About the Role

The work of an intern can have quantitative and qualitative aspects, depending on the needs of specific projects and the intern’s skills and interests. Projects range from subject matter research to data collection, to the preparation of economic, statistical, financial, and other forms of analysis. You will build technical skills and contribute to work that shapes important legal and business outcomes.

The intern program will start Fall 2026 with a planned end of May 2027. Interns will work up to 20 hours per week mainly in our downtown office. We’re committed to helping our interns succeed by providing them with dedicated mentors, training programs, hands-on learning opportunities and support from industry experts. Our internship program is a pipeline program, and we aim to convert interns to full-time Associates after graduation, assuming the role is a fit on both ends.

What You’ll Do

- Develop a practical understanding of industries, markets, legal claims, and business issues relevant to each engagement by gathering and reviewing information from our clients and their business, academic literature, legal documents, specialized industry resources, commercial databases, or other sources appropriate for the unique requirements of a project.

- Identify, collect, develop, maintain, analyze and review data, qualitative materials, spreadsheets and other files as dictated by complex project needs.

- Combine programming, model building, and statistical analysis skills using relational database and statistical programs to analyze a variety of subjects with software such as SQL, R, Stata, SAS, Python, or Snowflake.

- Interact with senior staff, experts, and clients to clearly communicate questions, findings, economic and business concepts, and recommendations.

- Demonstrate creativity and efficient analytical skills to develop novel solutions tailored to unique projects.

- Provide valuable contributions to client deliverables and expert reports.

Qualifications

- Progression towards a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Accounting, Business, Finance, Healthcare Administration or a related analytical field, with an expected graduation date between Winter 2027 and Summer 2028.

- 3.6 GPA or higher preferred.

- Demonstrated interest in applying analytics to business, financial, legal, regulatory, or policy questions.

- Strong quantitative, research, problem-solving, and written communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, client-service environment.

- Attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to producing high-quality work.

- Experience with statistical, econometric and programming tools such as Excel, Stata, R, Python, SQL or similar platforms is preferred.

- Fluency with AI tools is desirable.

- Candidates must be able to submit verification of their legal right to work in the United States, without company sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Practice Areas

This internship opportunity is specifically within our Health Analytics Practice. We tackle complex legal and operational challenges in the healthcare industry using data-driven, objective, and innovative approaches. Our experts lead advisory, risk management, and litigation matters, combining deep healthcare industry expertise with cutting edge research, analytics and financial modeling.

Locations

This internship position is in the Chicago office. Interns are expected to work in the office as much as possible to take full advantage of the mentorship, collaboration, and relationship-building opportunities that support their professional growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a copy of their resume, cover letter and transcript through the job posting. You can find the job application deadlines listed below:

- Deadline for priority review: September 5

- Deadline for secondary review: September 19

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. A member of the recruiting team will be in touch if there is an interest in scheduling interviews.

Salary Range: $25/hour - $40/hour

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

As a Quantitative Research Intern you will have an opportunity to solve challenging problems arising in a trading environment while utilizing the latest statistical scientific algorithms, machine learning techniques and derivatives pricing theory. Our teams emphasize cutting-edge innovative scientific research and collaboration, allowing you to gain a deeper understanding of quantitative trading. You will find great minds with diverse backgrounds, who are passionate about cultivating new ideas and exploring ways to bring them to life. You will use the team’s custom research infrastructure for simulation, back-testing, and validation of the proposed models. While your days will have you engrossed with complex technology projects, your evenings will be spent exploring the city with organized social events to truly discover what it’s like to live and work in Chicago or New York City.

How you will make an impact…

- Create practical solutions to problems presented in the trading environment on either a systematic equity trading desk or a fixed income options desk

- Conduct statistical analysis of market data, historical trends, and relationships across multiple asset classes

- Formulate and apply mathematical modeling, quantitative methods and machine learning techniques to identify and capture trading opportunities

- Work closely with traders and researchers to build and refine research infrastructure and tools

What you bring to the team…

- Are pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD in a technical discipline with a focus on Statistics, Optimization, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Quantitative Finance or related fields graduating between December 2027 and August 2028

- Proficiency in Python programming experience using the Python machine learning stack: numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, etc.

- Proficient programming skills with experience exploring large datasets

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills including a solid foundation of statistics knowledge

- Working knowledge of probability theory, stochastic calculus and numerical algorithms such as finite differences, Monte Carlo simulation, etc.

- Some exposure to Natural Language Processing and/or High-Performance Computing is a plus

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills to report research results as well as methodologies

- Added bonus if you have been published in a top tier journal focusing on Natural Language Processing or High-Performance Computing

What to expect during the internship

- Meaningful projects: Each project, advised by a trader, promotes a comprehensive learning experience and provides you with real-world work experience.

- Community: Throughout the summer, we host a variety of educational, social and team-building activities to explore the city, foster friendships and camaraderie.

- Housing: DRW provides fully furnished apartments located close to the office – making your morning commute as easy as possible.

- Mentorship: You’ll build a professional relationship with an experienced mentor in your field. Mentors and mentees meet to discuss goals, challenges and professional development and explore the city together at our mentor outings.

- Education: As the trading industry continually evolves, both in terms of new products and transaction methods, the future will present us with unique opportunities and challenges. You’ll complete an options course taught by an experienced trader and participate in a technology immersion course to better understand how technology and trading intersect.

DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

At Wilson, we are here to empower every human to live like an athlete. Passion. Creativity. Integrity. Teamwork. Ambition. Innovation. These are the qualities that have made Wilson Sporting Goods Co. the number one sports equipment brand in the world. We come together to win, grow, and celebrate. We all play for Team Wilson. We all have a role to play within our organization and are working towards the same goal. One team, one dream.

We believe that being an athlete isn’t something you do, it’s who you are. It’s a universal code of conduct, a way of seeing the world and how you show up every day. We seek out diverse voices and welcome all perspectives. Our team is composed of individuals with unique backgrounds, points of view and experiences. These perspectives create a rich and diverse culture in which we learn from one another through empathy and inclusion.

Evolving the sports world and being the best partner for players, athletes, and our community is no small task. We are continually looking to add enthusiastic, ambitious, team-first individuals who desire to make a difference — and who love to help others win. Together, we will create a better world through sport.

What You'll Do

Come build something with us. Our 12 week, project-based Summer Internship Program gives you the opportunity to make a real impact on work you will own from start to finish.

Throughout the program you will join a cohort of interns placed across Wilson, each owning future-oriented project work within their own team. Beyond your project, expect time with leaders, a look behind the scenes at how a 110-year old sports brand keeps moving, exposure to teams across the business, and events and team building that make the summer more than a job.

You will close out the 12 weeks by presenting the work you built over the summer.

As the Golf Product Insights & Data Intern, you will redesign how we structure product data for our pro club category and move the existing data into that new structure. Product data drives how products appear on our ecommerce site, how we report on sales, and how we build line plans, so inconsistency at the source creates confusion everywhere downstream. You will own the redesign, build the standard, and document it so the team can maintain it after the summer.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Audit the current pro club data: where it lives, how products are named and attributed, and where it is inconsistent, duplicated, or missing

- Meet with partners across product, commercial, ecommerce, sales, and finance to understand how each group uses the data and where it breaks down

- Design a data architecture with clear naming conventions, attribute standards, and hierarchy that mirrors how the product team plans and assorts the category (for example, club type, model family, loft, shaft, and price tier), so a new product is set up the same way every time

- Support line planning and seasonal assortment reviews by building attribute-level views that help the product team compare current and prior-season products

- Use AI tools to accelerate the work, classifying and cleaning legacy records, flagging anomalies, and drafting attribute mappings, with human review of all output

- Help set up and migrate SKU assortments in Centric to align with the new data structure

- Partner with cross functional teams to implement the new structure in the appropriate systems

- Map how the new structure flows into ecommerce presentation, sales reporting, and line planning, and rebuild one or two key reports to show the improvement

- Document the standards in a playbook, along with a short guide to the AI assisted workflow

- Present findings and recommendations for extending the approach to other product categories

What We're Looking For

An ideal candidate will be working toward a Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Merchandising, Business, or Operations and Supply Chain. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail oriented, and genuinely interested in how structure and organization make a business run better.

Additional qualifications include:

- Strong analytical skills and an interest in data and organization

- Experience with or strong interest in using AI tools for data work

- Interest in how data shapes ecommerce, sales reporting, and merchandising decisions

- Strong written and verbal communication, and comfort building relationships across teams

- High attention to detail

- Strong interest in golf

- Available to participate in the full time internship program for approximately 12 weeks over the summer

What We’ll Provide

A reasonable estimate of the pay range is $23.00/hr - $24.00/hr at the time of this posting. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, and/or training.

We also offer an innovative, inclusive, and people-first environment with perks, including:

- Learning sessions and mentorship with leaders across the business

- Team building outings

- Discounts on Wilson and Amer Sports products

- Summer hours

- Fun, active company outings around major sports events
